quests.instruction: Scan the agenda for when the closing panel takes place.
quests.passage: Conference Agenda: The event opens with registration at 8, followed by a keynote at 9, a networking break at 10:30, breakout sessions from 11 to 1, lunch at 1, and a closing panel at 3:30. Attendees are asked to select their breakout track during registration.
quests.hint: Search past the earlier agenda items and find the very last time listed.
quests.explanation: The closing panel is at 3:30; the other times belong to earlier parts of the agenda.

quests.instruction: Scan the summary for the retirement match percentage.
quests.passage: Employee Benefits Summary: Full-time staff receive fifteen paid vacation days, ten sick days, and five personal days annually, plus a 4 percent 401k match after one year of employment. Part-time staff receive a prorated version of vacation and sick time only.
quests.hint: Search for the number tied to the 401k, not the day counts.
quests.explanation: The 401k match is 4 percent; fifteen, ten, and five all refer to different types of days off.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for the store's Sunday hours.
quests.passage: Store Hours Notice: The store is open Monday through Friday from 9 to 8, Saturday from 10 to 6, and Sunday from 11 to 5, with extended hours until 9 during the holiday season.
quests.hint: Search specifically for the hours listed next to Sunday.
quests.explanation: Sunday hours are 11 to 5; the other hours belong to weekdays, Saturday, and the holiday season.

quests.instruction: Scan the itinerary for when the flight lands in Denver.
quests.passage: Travel Itinerary: The trip begins with a flight to Chicago at 7 a.m., a three-hour layover, a connecting flight to Denver landing at 1:15 p.m., a shuttle to the hotel arriving around 2, and a welcome dinner at 7 p.m.
quests.hint: Search for the time specifically tied to the Denver landing.
quests.explanation: The Denver flight lands at 1:15 p.m.; the other times belong to the Chicago flight, shuttle, and dinner.

quests.instruction: Scan the syllabus for how much the final project is worth.
quests.passage: Course Syllabus: The class meets twice weekly, includes three exams worth 20 percent each, a final project worth 25 percent, and participation worth 15 percent, with the lowest exam score dropped automatically.
quests.hint: Search for the percentage tied specifically to the final project.
quests.explanation: The final project is worth 25 percent; 20 and 15 percent belong to exams and participation.

quests.instruction: Scan the price list for the starting price of move-out cleaning.
quests.passage: Price List: Basic cleaning starts at $80, deep cleaning starts at $140, move-out cleaning starts at $180, and add-on services like window washing cost an additional $25 per visit.
quests.hint: Search for the figure tied specifically to move-out cleaning.
quests.explanation: Move-out cleaning starts at $180; the other prices belong to basic cleaning, deep cleaning, and add-ons.

quests.instruction: Scan the instructions for how long the full course should last.
quests.passage: Medical Instructions: Take one tablet every eight hours with food, avoid alcohol during treatment, complete the full ten-day course even if symptoms improve, and contact the office if a rash develops.
quests.hint: Search for the number tied to the word course.
quests.explanation: The full course lasts ten days; eight hours describes dosing frequency, a separate detail.

quests.instruction: Scan the terms for the length of the loan.
quests.passage: Loan Terms: The loan carries a 6.2 percent interest rate over a five-year term, with a $250 origination fee and no penalty for early repayment after the first twelve months.
quests.hint: Search for the number tied to the word term, not the interest rate.
quests.explanation: The loan term is five years; 6.2 percent is the interest rate, a separate figure.

quests.instruction: Scan the list for the fitness center's hours.
quests.passage: Amenities List: The complex includes a pool open from 8 to 10, a fitness center open 24 hours, a rooftop lounge open until midnight on weekends, and a dog park with no set hours.
quests.hint: Search for the hours listed specifically for the fitness center.
quests.explanation: The fitness center is open 24 hours; the other hours belong to the pool and rooftop lounge.

quests.instruction: Scan the description for the required years of experience.
quests.passage: Job Description Excerpt: The role requires three years of experience in customer service, a valid driver's license, availability for weekend shifts, and comfort using basic spreadsheet software.
quests.hint: Search for the number tied to the word experience.
quests.explanation: Three years of experience is required; the license, shifts, and software are separate requirements.

quests.instruction: Scan the notes for the oven temperature.
quests.passage: Recipe Notes: The dough needs to rest for ninety minutes, the oven should be preheated to 425 degrees, bake for twenty-two minutes, and let the bread cool for at least thirty minutes before slicing.
quests.hint: Search for the number tied to degrees, not the timing steps.
quests.explanation: The oven should be preheated to 425 degrees; the other numbers describe resting, baking, and cooling times.

quests.instruction: Scan the itinerary for the ceremony's start time.
quests.passage: Wedding Day Itinerary: Hair and makeup begins at 9, the first look photos are at noon, the ceremony starts at 4, cocktail hour runs from five to six, and dinner begins at seven.
quests.hint: Search for the number tied specifically to the word ceremony.
quests.explanation: The ceremony starts at 4; the other times belong to hair and makeup, photos, and dinner.

quests.instruction: Scan the list for which room hosts the data privacy session.
quests.passage: Conference Session List: Room 1 hosts a session on cloud security at 10, Room 2 hosts one on UX design at 10, Room 3 hosts one on data privacy at 11, and Room 4 hosts a panel on hiring at 2.
quests.hint: Search for the room name paired with the words data privacy.
quests.explanation: Data privacy is in Room 3; the other rooms host cloud security, UX design, and hiring.
quests.targetInfo: Room hosting the data privacy session

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for the one place alcohol is allowed.
quests.passage: Park Rules Notice: Dogs must be leashed at all times, fires are allowed only in designated pits, quiet hours run from 10 p.m. to 7 a.m., and alcohol is prohibited except in the reserved pavilion area.
quests.hint: Search for the exception mentioned right after the word alcohol.
quests.explanation: Alcohol is allowed only in the reserved pavilion area; the other rules cover dogs, fires, and quiet hours.

quests.instruction: Scan the terms for how soon a claim must be filed.
quests.passage: Warranty Terms: Parts are covered for three years, labor is covered for one year, accidental damage is not covered, and claims must be filed within thirty days of the issue.
quests.hint: Search for the number tied specifically to filing a claim.
quests.explanation: Claims must be filed within thirty days; three years and one year describe coverage lengths instead.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for the pool pass renewal deadline.
quests.passage: Condo Association Notice: Trash pickup is Tuesday, recycling is every other Thursday, guest parking is limited to 48 hours, and pool passes must be renewed annually by March 1st.
quests.hint: Search for the date tied specifically to pool passes.
quests.explanation: Pool passes renew by March 1st; Tuesday and Thursday relate to trash and recycling instead.

quests.instruction: Scan the terms for how long international shipping takes.
quests.passage: Shipping Terms: Domestic orders ship within two business days, international orders take seven to fourteen days, customs fees are the buyer's responsibility, and tracking is provided for all orders over $50.
quests.hint: Search for the number range tied specifically to international orders.
quests.explanation: International shipping takes seven to fourteen days; two business days applies only to domestic orders.

quests.instruction: Scan the schedule for the volunteer check-in window.
quests.passage: Volunteer Event Schedule: Setup begins at 7, volunteer check-in runs from 8 to 8:30, the event itself runs from 9 to 1, and cleanup wraps up by 2:30.
quests.hint: Search for the time range tied specifically to check-in.
quests.explanation: Check-in runs from 8 to 8:30; the other times belong to setup, the event, and cleanup.

quests.instruction: Scan the tiers for the price of the Gold membership.
quests.passage: Membership Tiers: The Bronze tier costs $10 monthly with no perks, Silver costs $20 with priority support, Gold costs $35 with priority support and free shipping, and Platinum costs $60 with all Gold perks plus early access to sales.
quests.hint: Search for the price tied specifically to the Gold tier.
quests.explanation: Gold costs $35; the other prices belong to Bronze, Silver, and Platinum.

quests.instruction: Scan the rules for how many free bags Premium Economy passengers get.
quests.passage: Flight Baggage Rules: Economy passengers may check one bag free, a second bag costs $45, Premium Economy passengers get two free bags, and Business class passengers get three free bags plus priority handling.
quests.hint: Search for the number tied specifically to Premium Economy.
quests.explanation: Premium Economy passengers get two free bags; one and three belong to Economy and Business class.

quests.instruction: Scan the menu for what's served on Friday.
quests.passage: School Lunch Menu: Monday features pasta, Tuesday features tacos, Wednesday features pizza, Thursday features a build-your-own salad bar, and Friday features fish and chips.
quests.hint: Search for the item listed specifically next to Friday.
quests.explanation: Friday's menu is fish and chips; the other items belong to earlier days of the week.

quests.instruction: Scan the policy for the return window for furniture.
quests.passage: Detailed Return Policy: Electronics may be returned within fifteen days unopened, clothing may be returned within thirty days with tags attached, furniture may be returned within seven days with a restocking fee, and final-sale items cannot be returned at all.
quests.hint: Search for the number tied specifically to furniture.
quests.explanation: Furniture can be returned within seven days; fifteen and thirty days apply to electronics and clothing.

quests.instruction: Scan the route for the time of the warehouse stop.
quests.passage: Multi-Stop Delivery Route: The driver's first stop is the downtown office at 9, the second stop is the warehouse at 10:30, the third stop is the retail store at noon, and the final stop is the residential drop-off at 2.
quests.hint: Search for the time tied specifically to the warehouse stop.
quests.explanation: The warehouse stop is at 10:30; the other times belong to the office, store, and residential stops.

quests.instruction: Scan the agreement for the pet fee amount.
quests.passage: Detailed Rental Agreement: Rent is $1,450 monthly, a $500 security deposit is required, pets are allowed with a $300 non-refundable pet fee, and the lease term is twelve months with a possible six-month renewal.
quests.hint: Search for the figure tied specifically to the word pet.
quests.explanation: The pet fee is $300; the other figures cover rent, the deposit, and the lease term.

quests.instruction: Scan the timetable for the time HIIT class meets.
quests.passage: Gym Class Timetable: Spin meets Monday and Wednesday at 6, yoga meets Tuesday and Thursday at 7, HIIT meets Monday and Friday at 5:30, and Pilates meets Wednesday only at 8.
quests.hint: Search for the time tied specifically to HIIT.
quests.explanation: HIIT meets at 5:30; the other times belong to Spin, yoga, and Pilates.

quests.instruction: Scan the coverage details for the comprehensive deductible.
quests.passage: Detailed Insurance Coverage: Liability coverage is capped at $100,000, collision coverage has a $500 deductible, comprehensive coverage has a $250 deductible, and roadside assistance is included at no extra cost.
quests.hint: Search for the deductible tied specifically to comprehensive coverage.
quests.explanation: The comprehensive deductible is $250; $100,000 and $500 belong to liability and collision coverage.

quests.instruction: Scan the ticketing details for the backstage pass price.
quests.passage: Detailed Event Ticketing: General admission costs $25, VIP costs $75 and includes early entry, backstage passes cost $150 and include a meet-and-greet, and children under six enter free.
quests.hint: Search for the price tied specifically to backstage passes.
quests.explanation: Backstage passes cost $150; the other prices apply to general admission, VIP, and children.

quests.instruction: Scan the specifications for the storage capacity.
quests.passage: Detailed Product Specifications: The laptop weighs 3.2 pounds, has a 14-inch display, includes 16GB of memory, offers 512GB of storage, and comes with a one-year manufacturer warranty.
quests.hint: Search for the figure tied specifically to storage, not memory.
quests.explanation: Storage capacity is 512GB; 16GB refers to memory, a different specification.

quests.instruction: Scan the schedule for how many cashiers work the afternoon shift.
quests.passage: Detailed Staffing Schedule: The morning shift needs three cashiers and one manager, the afternoon shift needs four cashiers and one manager, and the evening shift needs two cashiers and one manager.
quests.hint: Search for the cashier count tied specifically to the afternoon shift.
quests.explanation: The afternoon shift needs four cashiers; three and two belong to the morning and evening shifts.

quests.instruction: Scan the policy for the window that qualifies for a full refund.
quests.passage: Detailed Membership Cancellation Policy: Members may cancel anytime online, cancellations take effect at the end of the current cycle, refunds are not issued for partial months, and members who cancel within the first seven days receive a full refund.
quests.hint: Search for the number tied specifically to a full refund.
quests.explanation: Canceling within seven days earns a full refund; the other phrases describe general cancellation rules.
